candidate_relations.reason: The record supports frontotemporal degeneration with bulbar motor neuron involvement, including tongue atrophy and neurogenic EMG changes. Although parkinsonian features and severe dopaminergic loss are present, the candidate omits the required MND component and labels the disorder as parkinsonism-17, which is not the referenced TBK1-associated FTLD-MND diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Asserts an FTD-parkinsonism syndrome rather than the required FTLD-MND composite diagnosis.
